agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/lexer.py Lexer.get_tokens(): removed the erroneous early TypeError raise for bytes input and restored the decode-on-bytes logic (using explicit encoding, else utf-8, else unicode-escape fallback), moving the TypeError to apply only to genuinely unsupported (non-str, non-bytes, non-file-like) types. Verified sqlparse.parse(b'SELECT \xc3\xbc') and sqlparse.format(b'SELECT \xc3\xbc') now correctly decode non-ASCII bytes input instead of raising TypeError.
